bugs.error_message: Host game page shows "Live Connection Lost" modal immediately; SignalR connection.start() rejects (negotiate 404) in the Docker Compose deployment
bugs.root_cause: VITE_SIGNALR_URL build arg in docker-compose.yml and frontend/Dockerfile was set to http://localhost:5000/hubs/game (full hub URL). gameHub.ts contract expects a host-only origin and appends /hubs/game itself, so the client negotiated against http://localhost:5000/hubs/game/hubs/game which 404s. Only reproduced in the container build; npm run dev / local dist fall through to the http://localhost:5000 default and work.
bugs.fix: Set VITE_SIGNALR_URL=http://localhost:5000 (origin only, no path) in docker-compose.yml and frontend/Dockerfile, matching the frontend/.env.example contract and the VITE_API_URL fallback logic in gameHub.ts. Verified the rebuilt bundle resolves the hub base to http://localhost:5000 and appends /hubs/game once.

bugs.error_message: POST /api/games/{id}/advance -> 409 Game.InvalidStateTransition ("That action is not available for the current game state") when clicking Next Question from QUESTION_RESULTS
bugs.root_cause: GameTransition.AdvanceToNextQuestion allowed only From=[Leaderboard], forcing QUESTION_RESULTS -> LEADERBOARD -> QUESTION_ACTIVE. Skipping the (optional) leaderboard was impossible; StartNextQuestionCommandHandler CanFire check rejected the advance and the error mapped to HTTP 409.
bugs.fix: Added GameStatus.QuestionResults to the AdvanceToNextQuestion.From set so both QUESTION_RESULTS -> QUESTION_ACTIVE and LEADERBOARD -> QUESTION_ACTIVE are valid. Handler already had xmin optimistic-concurrency + QuestionActive idempotent re-entry + NoMoreQuestions past the last question; unchanged. Frontend: useHostGame now optimistically applies the QuestionStarted REST response (status+window sync, not only the SignalR event) via a shared applyQuestionStarted; HostGameControls disables Next Question with a tooltip on the final question (hasNextQuestion from currentQuestionIndex vs totalQuestions). Docs updated (FR-4 table, realtime-protocol advance row, design-doc state diagram).

bugs.error_message: Keyboard pickup immediately ends the question drag
bugs.root_cause: The pickup key bubbles to a window key listener installed by the React discrete-event effect, so the same Space or Enter also drops the card.
bugs.fix: Stop propagation on the pickup key; subsequent keyboard events reach the active drag listener. Verified Space, End, Enter, Escape and focus preservation.

bugs.error_message: Floating question preview obscures the destination message
bugs.root_cause: The preview overlaps the drop marker when following a handle near the top of the question card.
bugs.fix: Place the preview above or below the destination when space permits and keep the marker above the preview. Verified desktop and touch screenshots.

bugs.error_message: Linux build and browser verification dependencies missing
bugs.root_cause: The shared frontend node_modules lacks Linux native bindings; the available browser needs NSS, NSPR and ALSA libraries. The Babel plugin also requires Node 22.12 or newer.
bugs.fix: Verified a separate source copy using npm ci with the existing lockfile and Node 24. Loaded browser libraries from temporary extracted packages. No project dependency or system package changes.

bugs.error_message: CS0246 ParticipantPresenceMutationResponse could not be found
bugs.root_cause: The feature request records referenced new contracts from Kahoot.Application.Games.Common without importing that namespace.
bugs.fix: Imported Kahoot.Application.Games.Common in the attach, detach, and removal request contract files.

bugs.error_message: Connection string 'DefaultConnection' is empty during dotnet ef migrations add
bugs.root_cause: The hardened design-time context factory requires an explicit connection string and the migration command was run without ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection.
bugs.fix: Reran migration generation with a non-secret local design-time connection string supplied only to the command environment.

bugs.error_message: Frontend Prettier check reported six unformatted files
bugs.root_cause: Phase 5 edits and pre-existing source formatting did not match the repository Prettier configuration.
bugs.fix: Format the five in-scope files, preserve the unrelated file, and rerun targeted and repository formatting validation.

bugs.error_message: Clean Node 22.12 install reported unsupported engine requirements for ESLint 10
bugs.root_cause: The resolved ESLint 10 packages require Node 22.13 or newer even though the Rolldown plugin only requires 22.12.
bugs.fix: Raised the Node 22 minimum, .nvmrc, and Docker build image consistently to 22.13.0.

bugs.error_message: Backend Docker build could not resolve mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0.112
bugs.root_cause: The locally installed .NET SDK patch number was assumed to be an available Microsoft container tag, but MCR does not publish that exact tag.
bugs.fix: Verified Microsoft container metadata, pinned the build image to the published SDK 10.0.302 tag while retaining the root 10.0.1xx SDK policy, and retained the available ASP.NET 10.0.12 runtime tag.

bugs.error_message: Rebuilt backend container entered a restart loop with exit code 139
bugs.root_cause: Under investigation after the first startup attempt with the corrected SDK and runtime image tags.
bugs.fix: Inspect startup logs and runtime configuration, correct the verified cause, then rerun health and migration checks.

bugs.error_message: Docker could not address the previous backend and frontend image identifiers during local stack restoration
bugs.root_cause: The image identifiers recorded in the old container labels were no longer present as locally addressable image objects after replacement.
bugs.fix: Inspect remaining local image metadata and restore the prior stack without modifying its database; use isolated Phase 5 containers for validation.

bugs.error_message: Isolated frontend Nginx could not resolve its expected backend upstream and the readiness curl lingered
bugs.root_cause: The temporary backend container lacked the network alias expected by the production Nginx configuration, and the ad hoc readiness curl had no maximum duration.
bugs.fix: Attach the isolated backend with the expected temporary network alias, restart the frontend, and use bounded curl readiness checks.

bugs.error_message: Isolated API scenario setup failed because jq is not installed
bugs.root_cause: The ad hoc smoke setup assumed jq was available in the local shell.
bugs.fix: Parse the small JSON responses with the already installed Node runtime instead of adding a system dependency.

bugs.error_message: TypeError: crypto.randomUUID is not a function
bugs.root_cause: The question dialog used crypto.randomUUID for ephemeral React keys, but randomUUID is unavailable when the application is served from a non-secure HTTP origin.
bugs.fix: Use the existing stable default IDs and component-local sequential IDs for newly added draft choices, removing the secure-context dependency.

bugs.error_message: Creating a worker from blob: violates Content Security Policy directive script-src 'self'
bugs.root_cause: canvas-confetti creates a Blob Web Worker, but the Nginx CSP omitted worker-src and therefore fell back to script-src, which did not allow blob workers.
bugs.fix: Add an explicit worker-src 'self' blob: directive to both development and production Nginx CSP headers.

bugs.error_message: POST http://20.19.48.78/api/auth/refresh returned 401 after page reload
bugs.root_cause: Production issues the HttpOnly refresh cookie with Secure=true, but the public deployment exposes only plain HTTP. Chrome therefore does not persist or send the cookie; the frontend sends an empty refresh body and the API returns Auth.InvalidRefreshToken.
bugs.fix: Added typed Auth:SecureCookies configuration with a secure default, set AUTH_SECURE_COOKIES=false for the explicitly approved HTTP-only deployment, and wired both Compose environments. HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, CSRF/origin checks, browser storage, and token rotation remain unchanged; HTTPS migration requires setting the value to true.

bugs.error_message: CS0136: A local or parameter named 'currentQuestionIndex' cannot be declared in this scope
bugs.root_cause: Two pattern variables in sibling control-flow branches used the same name, and C# pattern-variable scope made the earlier declaration conflict with the later declaration.
bugs.fix: Renamed the re-entry branch variable to activeQuestionIndex and retained currentQuestionIndex for the normal advance branch.

bugs.error_message: POST /api/games/{id}/advance returned 409 Game.NoMoreQuestions after question 6 of a 19-question game
bugs.root_cause: Deleting a quiz question left a gap in its OrderIndex values, CreateGame copied the sparse values into immutable snapshots, and StartNextQuestion treated the next logical zero-based position as an exact stored OrderIndex. The affected sequence was 0 through 5 followed by 7 through 19, so lookup of index 6 failed even though 13 questions remained.
bugs.fix: Advance and start now load the Nth ordered snapshot, re-entry resolves the current snapshot by ID, new game snapshots receive contiguous logical indexes, question deletion compacts subsequent indexes transactionally, and advance conflicts emit structured state/index/count diagnostics.
